hook: SAG-AFTRA and the Writers Guild are fighting to stop OpenAI from using creative work without permission.

sections.voiceover: SAG-AFTRA and the Writers Guild are fighting to stop OpenAI from using creative work without permission.
Why did these unions compile a 34-page brief to present before a federal judge?
However, the Wikimedia Foundation also filed a brief challenging fair use claims by Microsoft and Anthropic.
Unions argue that unlicensed AI training causes systemic harm to the livelihoods of creative professionals.
A federal judge must now decide if the unions' 34-page legal brief holds up in court.
